source: Top-side copper, solder mask, silkscreen, drill and placement data converted from the BeagleBoard-xM rev C1 manufacturing files (https://github.com/beagleboard/beagleboard-xm), by Gerald Coley of BeagleBoard.org, CC BY-SA 3.0. Units are 0.1 mm from the top-left board corner, y down. Outline rows are line segments. Part rows are footprint, x, y, rotation and the assembly-drawing body box.
